title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Tariff Clause: Seasoning Charge on a Deferral
content:
**Clause.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans deferral fee carries a seasoning charge set by how many installments the loan has billed: 50.00 is added when fewer than 2 have been billed, 25.00 when 2 or 3 have been billed, and nothing when 4 or more have been billed. The charge is added to the deferral fee after every multiplication of the fee has been made; the total is rounded once to cents and is never less than zero.

## Installments billed

The installment bills booked on the loan since funding, as its transaction history shows them, counted on the grant date.

| Installments billed | Seasoning charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 50.00 |
| 2 or 3 | 25.00 |
| 4 or more | none |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A semiannual Irrigation System Loan that has billed one installment: 50.00 is added.
- A monthly Used Equipment Loan that has billed three installments: 25.00 is added.
- A loan that has billed four installments: nothing is added.
